title: Come back
original_lyrics:
[verse]
If I keep holding out will the light shine through under this

[bridge]
I've been wishing out the day
Oh oh oh come back
I have been planning out all that I' say to you
Since you slipped away, know that I still remain true
I've been wishing out the day
Please say that if you had to go now
I wouldn't have lost you another way
From wherever you are
Ohh oh oh come back
And these days they linger on
And in the night I've been waiting for
The real possibility that I may meet you in my dreams
Then I go to sleep
If I don't fall apart will my memory stay clear
So you had to go and I had to remain here

[bridge]
So far away and yet you feel so close
And I'm not gonna question any other way
There must be an open door for you to come back
And the days they linger on
And every night well I'm waiting for
The real possibility that I may meet you in my dreams
Sometimes you're there and you're talking back to me

[chorus]
It's OK it's OK
I'll be here come back come back
I'll be here come back come back
I'll be here come back come back
Ooh ooh ooh ooh ooooooooh
Ooh ooh ooh ooh ooooooooh
